protocol.name: umbriel_input_capture_v1
protocol.description: Private bridge for the InputCapture portal backend. All coordinates use logical desktop units. Creating a session grants no access. Each start requires compositor-owned user approval; application labels are untrusted. Clients must not assume that an enabled session is actively capturing.

request.name: expire_scope
request.description: The portal forwards the disappearance of the requesting application's D-Bus peer. This only expires mode-one grants issued to this bridge client and application instance; durable grants are unaffected.

interface.name: umbriel_input_capture_session_v1
interface.description: Request identifiers correlate replies. Status values are zero for success, one for user cancellation, and two for failure. A session may start once. Destroying the object stops capture and closes the EIS connection. Explicit disable and release do not emit disabled or deactivated events.

request.name: set_persistence
request.description: Mode zero requests a single session, one lasts for the application instance within this bridge client, and two lasts until revoked. The restore token is an opaque compositor grant, not the application's public portal restore token. A missing or invalid grant requires physical approval. Application labels alone never restore permission. This request is valid only before start.

event.name: grant

description.summary: approved permission to restore a later session

event.description: Sent before started for a successful remembered grant. The application identifier and approved capabilities are checked by the compositor on restoration. The opaque token must be kept private and is consumed by a successful restoration. Use the returned token for the next session.
